watches.name: Simurg
watches.description: At the heart of the Pegasus sits a golden sun. Around it, time is set in motion: a winged horse in flight across an amber herringbone guilloché dial, carried on an open, skeletonised arm, with the minutes read on a travelling disc and the gear train left in plain sight. The first piece of the Devran Collection, Pegasus is built on a principle older than watchmaking itself: that time is not a line, but a turning. Every moving part on the dial is there to be seen, and every one of them means something. Case diameter: 42 mm Case thickness: 12.7 mm Movement: modified Miyota 8215 automatic Crystal: domed sapphire with anti-reflective coating Dial: amber herringbone guilloché with central sun and visible gear train Strap: brown smooth calf leather Time, set in motion.

watches.name: Gates - Steel / Malakit
watches.description: Drawn from the intellectual and architectural zenith of the Great Eastern tradition, the Gates Collection redefines time as something not merely measured, but carried. Where history and inspiration converge with first-class craftsmanship and the trusted precision of Miyota, the Gates Collection is composed entirely of individually numbered pieces. Each timepiece, finished with a 316L stainless steel case, sapphire crystal, and the finest Italian calfskin strap, is designed to let you wear history on your wrist, with honour. The Gurlevik Gates Collection is unparalleled in design originality and craftsmanship. The custom-cut sapphire crystal applied over the domed case surface is not an off-the-shelf fabrication, it is produced exclusively for Gurlevik, a testament to bespoke workmanship. With this collection and beyond, we will continue to dream and dare the untried for Turkish watchmaking.

watches.name: Ferseng
watches.description: In Turkish, the lozenge has a name every child knows: baklava dilimi, the baklava slice. It's the shape of the sweet, yes, but long before that it was the shape of armor scales, of kilim borders, of the brickwork diamonds climbing Seljuk minarets. Our bracelet carries rows of these raised, polished lozenges set into brushed steel links, a pattern that reads as texture from across the room and as craftsmanship from across the table. A field of crimson, cut in guilloché, thousands of facets radiating from the center like the lattice of a palace screen catching evening light. These colors was never a casual color in the old world. It was the color of sultans' kaftans, of Bursa silk, of the banners that crossed three continents. We gave it a dial. The case is our signature decagon, ten facets, drawn from the same geometry that built the girih patterns of Seljuk and Ottoman craft. Brushed surfaces meet polished chamfers at every edge. The integrated bracelet continues the language: a lattice of raised lozenges, part armor, part ornament, tapering to the clasp like the scales of a very well-dressed serpent.

watches.name: Lale
watches.description: Where the Imperial Garden Meets the Horology Some dials tell time. This one tells a story one written in the language of Ottoman atelier. Tulips and carnations, the sacred flowers of the imperial court, unfurl across a deep crimson ground, their gilded stems curling in the sinuous arabesques of classical Rumi ornament. Every tendril, every petal, is a reference to a civilization that elevated beauty to a form of devotion. At the heart of the composition, a mother-of-pearl subdial floats like a full moon above the garden, its luminous surface carrying blued-steel hands and Arabic numerals in the restrained tradition of the great pocket watch makers. Below, exposed and unhurried, a flywheel. rotates within its gilt cage, here framed by the same ornamental geometry that once adorned the walls of Topkapı. The polished steel case, smooth and architectural, neither competes with nor apologizes for what it holds. It is simply a frame for a masterwork. Technical Details Case: 316L Stainless Steel Movement: Yinbei Openheart Flywheel Movement Power Reserve: 45 Hours Diameter: 40 mm Lug to lug: 47 mm Thickness: 13 mm 5 ATM

watches.name: The Dome 02
watches.description: The Domes Collection Conceived as an act of reverence toward Hagia Sophia, The Domes collection draws its architectural soul from the pendentives and adorned squinches of Ottoman dome masonry, translating centuries of sacred geometry into steel and sapphire. Powered by the Miyota 9039 movement, its silhouette achieves a remarkable slenderness of 8.7 mm, a profile as restrained as the spaces between arches. The case measures 39 mm in diameter, extending to 45 mm lug-to-lug, worn close to the wrist like a whisper of a forgotten empire.

watches.name: Discovery
watches.description: Inspired by celestial instruments and the pursuit of knowledge through the night sky, this timepiece centers on the astrolabe as both symbol and structure. The deep blue star field contrasts against a lighter outer dial, creating a sense of depth and orientation. Fine detailing and balanced proportions allow the complexity of the design to remain legible, calm, and composed. Every element is deliberate, from the central astrolabe motif to the restrained use of color and form. Designed for comfort and daily wear, this watch carries a quiet intellectual presence. It is a timepiece that reflects reflection, inquiry, and continuity, inviting the wearer to engage with time not just as measure, but as meaning.

Designed to sit comfortably on the wrist, this watch is meant to be worn daily while offering something deeper on closer inspection. It is a timepiece that rewards curiosity, carrying a quiet narrative of exploration, knowledge, and continuity.
